entries.title: Proverbs 27:1
segments: ¶Do not boast about tomorrow, For you do not know what a day may bring forth.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:2
segments: ¶Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; A stranger, and not your own lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:3
segments: ¶A stone [is] heavy and sand [is] weighty, But a fool's wrath [is] heavier than both of them.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:4
segments: Wrath [is] cruel and anger a torrent, But who [is] able to stand before jealousy?

entries.title: Proverbs 27:5
segments: ¶Open rebuke [is] better Than love carefully concealed.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:6
segments: Faithful [are] the wounds of a friend, But the kisses of an enemy [are] deceitful.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:7
segments: ¶A satisfied soul loathes the honeycomb, But to a hungry soul every bitter thing [is] sweet.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:8
segments: ¶Like a bird that wanders from its nest [Is] a man who wanders from his place.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:9
segments: ¶Ointment and perfume delight the heart, And the sweetness of a man's friend [gives delight] by hearty counsel.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:10
segments: Do not forsake your own friend or your father's friend, Nor go to your brother's house in the day of your calamity; Better [is] a neighbor nearby than a brother far away.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:11
segments: ¶My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, That I may answer him who reproaches me.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:12
segments: ¶A prudent [man] foresees evil [and] hides himself; The simple pass on [and] are punished.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:13
segments: ¶Take the garment of him who is surety for a stranger, And hold it in pledge [when] he is surety for a seductress.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:14
segments: ¶He who blesses his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, It will be counted a curse to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:15
segments: ¶A continual dripping on a very rainy day And a contentious woman are alike;

entries.title: Proverbs 27:16
segments: Whoever restrains her restrains the wind, And grasps oil with his right hand.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:17
segments: ¶[As] iron sharpens iron, So a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:18
segments: ¶Whoever keeps the fig tree will eat its fruit; So he who waits on his master will be honored.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:19
segments: ¶As in water face [reflects] face, So a man's heart [reveals] the man.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:20
segments: ¶Hell and Destruction are never full; So the eyes of man are never satisfied.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:21
segments: ¶The refining pot [is] for silver and the furnace for gold, And a man [is valued] by what others say of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:22
segments: ¶Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with crushed grain, [Yet] his foolishness will not depart from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:23
segments: ¶Be diligent to know the state of your flocks, [And] attend to your herds;

entries.title: Proverbs 27:24
segments: For riches [are] not forever, Nor does a crown [endure] to all generations.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:25
segments: [When] the hay is removed, and the tender grass shows itself, And the herbs of the mountains are gathered in,

entries.title: Proverbs 27:26
segments: The lambs [will provide] your clothing, And the goats the price of a field;

entries.title: Proverbs 27:27
segments: [You shall have] enough goats' milk for your food, For the food of your household, And the nourishment of your maidservants.
